svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: The name site-lpc8lqa.par-1.example.com has the prefix site-, the base-36 label lpc8lqa, and the zone. The label decodes to 47244640258, which is 11 shifted left by 32 bits, or tenant 2. OpenResty puts the numbers into the mesh address fdaa:1:0:2::b: the region prefix from config, tenant 2, and VM 11.
